{"report":"Implemented the transfer progress fix in src/workflow.py.

- Listener now attaches before start, so synchronous warm progress is rendered.
- Attempt handle is bound before start callbacks, preserving safe navigation/cleanup under reentrancy.
- Per-subscription packet sequencing prevents late-decoding older frames from rolling the display backward; audit records still receive every decoded frame.
- Stale prior-attempt frames cannot paint a retried/current panel.
- Telemetry behavior was left unchanged.

Archived the patch as /workspace/transfer-progress-fix.patch (reverse dry-run validated).

Validation passed: focused warm-frame, out-of-order decoding, audit, and telemetry checks; Python compilation; /usr/bin/python3 -B --version reports Python 3.8.10.

Not covered: host-specific asynchronous/reentrant behavior beyond the in-memory focused harness."}
